bug_info.bug_desc: When RV32B is set to RV32BNone (B-extension disabled), the gorci instruction (opcode OP_IMM, funct3=101, instr[31:27]=5'b0_0101) is not properly flagged as illegal. The decoder logic for the 5'b0_0101 case in funct3=101 only handles the RV32BFull case (setting illegal_insn=0 for gorci) and the RV32BBalanced case for orc.b (instr[24:20]==5'b00111), but lacks an else branch to set illegal_insn=1 when RV32B is RV32BNone. This causes the instruction to be treated as legal, allowing it to execute and modify the register file and CSRs without raising an illegal instruction exception.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add an else branch to the condition checking RV32B for the 5'b0_0101 case in the funct3=101 decode block. When RV32B is RV32BNone and the instruction is not orc.b (instr[24:20] != 5'b00111), set illegal_insn=1'b1 to correctly flag the gorci instruction as illegal.
